name: XPERT Auto Detailing Jax
address_source: Consistent across poyst.com, mobiledetailing.io and hiredetailing.com listings.
email_note: Deep search per pipeline Fase 1.7: Instagram web_profile_info API blocked twice (400 'asset deleted' error, same failure pattern as prior sessions), IG mirrors imginn.com and picuki.com both blocked by Cloudflare challenge (max-2-attempts limit reached, moved on). Facebook page (facebook.com/XPERTJAX) and its /about subpage both returned no usable content via WebFetch and curl (blocked/empty). Checked 6 directory listings (poyst.com, mobiledetailing.io, hiredetailing.com, giftly.com, cardetailingnow.com, Yelp via giftly/hiredetailing extracts) -- all explicitly state no email on file. Nextdoor business page HTML has no email field, only phone/message/call buttons. No linktree/beacons/poplme link found anywhere in search results. No email found through any verified channel; recorded as null.
website_check: No dedicated domain found in any search result or directory listing; every listing's 'website' field points to instagram.com/xpertjax. Confirmed mobile-only online presence (IG/FB + directories), consistent with task brief.
hours_source: Confirmed independently by Wheree.com listing (via giftly.com cross-reference) and hiredetailing.com listing, both stating 'Monday-Sunday: 7AM-7PM'. Resolves the 7pm vs 8pm ambiguity in favor of 7pm.
about: Jason Campioni owns and runs XPERT Auto Detailing Jax, a 100% mobile detailing operation serving Jacksonville, Jacksonville Beach and the surrounding area. Jason comes directly to the customer's home or office rather than requiring a shop visit. The business is described by Jason himself (Nextdoor business bio) as 'local and family owned.' Customers repeatedly single out his punctuality, communication and meticulous attention to detail across trucks, SUVs, sedans and exotic/sports cars alike.
about_quote_owner: Thank you for choosing XPERT Auto Detailing! We are 100% mobile and proud to serve our customers all over the Jacksonville area. We are a local family owned business and we appreciate you spreading the word. See you soon!
about_quote_source: Nextdoor business page, 'Our story' section (owner's own words).

services.name: Interior Detailing

services.name: Exterior Detailing
services.description: Hand wash, clay bar decontamination and wax/paint enhancement for a deep, reflective shine.

services.name: Full Service Detail
services.description: Interior and exterior combined in one mobile visit, the most requested package.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.description: Longer-lasting paint protection and gloss, applied on site.

services.name: Odor & Smoke Removal
services.description: Specialized treatment to remove smoke, odor and stains from cabin surfaces.

services.name: Fleet Services
services.description: Recurring detailing for business vehicles and small fleets.

services_source: Cross-referenced across poyst.com ('Interior Detailing', 'Exterior Detailing', 'Mobile Detailing Service', 'Deep Cleaning for Used Cars'), mobiledetailing.io ('Interior Detailing, Exterior Detailing, Full Service Detailing, Ceramic Coating, Fleet Services') and WebSearch summaries mentioning steam cleaning, clay bar, paint correction and smoke/odor removal. No fixed price list is published anywhere. Nextdoor's own AI-generated community summary paragraph mentions 'affordable pricing, currently at $50' but does not attribute that figure to any specific named service and is not a business-published price, so per the strict-truth rule it was NOT used as a priced line item anywhere on the site (no invented prices).
cta_note: No online booking system found (no Booksy/Square/GlossGenius link anywhere). CTAs go to tel:+19047427496 and Instagram DM (https://instagram.com/xpertjax), per task brief.

reviews_note: First 4 quotes were supplied in the task brief as already-verified verbatim Google reviews and are used as given. A 5th (Donna Price) was independently pulled this session from poyst.com, a Google-reviews aggregator for this business, along with 3 more corroborating quotes (Robert McDonough, Carrie Deaton, Chris Kemph, Celina M.) not used on-site but available if more are needed. The unattributed 'best of the best' quote from the brief was not independently re-sourced this session (no attributable name), so it was left out of the on-site cards per the verbatim-with-name preference, but 5 named quotes were available so nothing was lost.
language_source: All sourced text (Nextdoor bio, reviews, directory descriptions) is in English; Jacksonville FL is an English-language market with no Spanish-language signal found.
review_count_note: Inconsistent across scrapers: hiredetailing.com states exactly '202 Google reviews', multiple independent WebSearch summaries state 'over 190 reviews' / '100+ 5-star reviews on Google'. Yelp itself shows only 4-24 reviews (a different, much smaller review pool than Google). Presented on-site as '5.0 . 200+ reviews on Google', the most consistently corroborated approximate figure, not a precise invented count.

images.curation_note: 9 real, verified photos used (8 vehicle/detail/mobile-branding photos + 1 logo), within the 6-14 target. All visually inspected one by one: no selfies, no closed-eyes/mid-procedure shots, no text-overlay screenshots (aside from the intentional 'about' photo showing the business's own door magnet, which is proof of the real mobile service, not a caption overlay). Strong variety across trucks (F-150, Super Duty), SUV (Macan) and sports/exotic (Mustang), plus close-up wheel detail and two clean interior shots.

brand_vibe: The business's own logo is a black stencil-style muscle car graphic with bold black wordmark on white; real photos show a mix of trucks, an SUV and sports cars finished to a deep glossy shine, shot mostly in Jacksonville driveways and parking lots under bright daylight. This reads as clean, precise and automotive rather than soft/spa-like: a deep charcoal/near-black base with a cool chrome-steel and electric blue accent (echoing the blue Acura and the reflective, glass-like paint finishes in the real photos) fits better than a warm gold palette used on other builds.
